Better to fail fast
than never try.

I train like I’ve never won.
I compete like I’ve never lost.

Thoughts aren’t linear.
Neither is progress.

Life is like golf, full of ups and downs. A rough front nine doesn’t mean you can’t turn it around on the back nine.

A diamond is just a piece of coal that never gave up.

People give places
their soul.

If you let the noise stop you,
you’ll never leave your mark.

When tomorrow is uncertain, peace is its own kind of happiness.

I miss the people, not the place.
They’re what make it matter.
